note: Sister Circle, source 1:25.95-2:04.11 (the clip from the 2026-10-24 issue report 'after the 20 second mark where it splits to two stacked frames the auto focusing is jarring'). Labels from a 1 fps contact sheet and the per-second face boxes; shot changes are the cuts media.detectScenes finds on the clip. 0-12 s a tweet card with a small phone video (fit); then the guest's close-up (face, x ~0.47) alternates every 1-3 s with a wide four-person couch shot (guest x 0.22-0.26, hosts 0.57 and 0.73, faces ~0.12 tall) and one 1 s two-shot of two hosts (x 0.31 / 0.67). Wide four-person shots are `fit` (three or more comparable faces: a crop cannot hold them, a split picks two), the 1.1 s hosts two-shot is its own split piece (a detected cut may bound a piece down to MIN_SHOT_SEC), and only the 0.2 s tail is uncertain. The report's render had no scene cuts (the project had not run the scenes refine step): the segmenter held one split from 22 s to the end, so the top pane slid between the guest (x 0.47) and the host at x 0.22 inside the wide shots, and the bottom pane framed an empty seat during the guest's close-ups. Same static 'Sister Circle Live' logo bug bottom-left as shots-couch-multicam. Samples were generated from a 720p copy of the same video (the detector sees 320x240 either way).
